concept: A restrained interaction model where motion behaves like directed attention: one calm hero sequence, clear affordance feedback, and no interaction that makes reading or navigation harder.

principles.name: Motion earns its weight
principles.guidance: Animate only when it clarifies hierarchy, progress, affordance, or narrative pacing.

principles.name: Hero is the experiment
principles.guidance: Keep experimental cinematic behavior isolated to the hero canvas; downstream portfolio sections remain direct and scannable.

principles.name: Reduced motion is a parallel design
principles.guidance: When prefers-reduced-motion is active, replace animated drift with static layering and opacity-free hierarchy changes.

principles.name: Every input path works
principles.guidance: Hover, focus, touch, and keyboard states must all reveal equivalent meaning.

principles.name: One signature, repeated with restraint
principles.guidance: Choose a single memorable behavior for the weekly hero and reuse its timing language consistently rather than stacking unrelated effects.

hero.entry: Text and surface layers appear in a measured sequence under 700ms total.
hero.ambient: Optional slow signal trace or parallax depth under 8px of movement.
hero.exit: No forced transition; scrolling remains native.
hero.reducedMotion: Static composition with visible hierarchy and no ambient loop.

microinteractions.target: primary links and calls to action
microinteractions.behavior: Use color, underline, or border contrast changes with a short 120-180ms transition.
microinteractions.accessibility: Do not rely on color alone; preserve visible focus outlines.

microinteractions.behavior: Use subtle shadow or border emphasis, not scale jumps.
microinteractions.accessibility: Avoid hover-only disclosure of essential content.

microinteractions.behavior: Use small translate and opacity changes only when reduced motion is not requested.
microinteractions.accessibility: Content must remain present in source order and readable without animation.

states.focus: High-contrast outline or ring using the accent color against the warm background.
states.hover: Slight accent or border emphasis; no cursor trail.
states.active: Small tonal compression or border darkening.
states.disabled: Muted surface with adequate text contrast for labels when visible.

performance.budget: Prefer CSS transitions and lightweight canvas/SVG motifs before WebGL.
avoid: dependencies used for one small transition
preferredTechniques: transform and opacity for non-essential animation
requestAnimationFrame only for measured ambient effects

accessibility.keyboard: All interactive affordances must be reachable and visible by keyboard.
accessibility.contrast: Text and interactive labels must pass AA against their surfaces.

avoid: visual effects that obscure body text
